Hi team,

Attached: wire_instructions_redwood.pdf and VAT_breakdown_INV-2028-091.pdf (two brief stubs).
Plan: if you can confirm the wire today, we will mark the invoice as paid and release access tokens as scheduled. If you prefer card retry, let me know the best time and we can trigger a second attempt.

Two quick asks so AP doesn't have delays:
- Beneficiary name must be exactly "Redwood Inference, Inc."
- Please include the invoice number in the wire reference field

If Palmera needs a temporary escrow for dispute reasons, we can route payment to a short-term escrow account and reconcile on receipt.

Thanks,
Sofia

Marissa Cole
